limits: Bounded search, not proof that no qualifying photo exists anywhere.
No native-browser or image-pixel verification obtained.
Timeouts/401/SSL errors and unpopulated map UI counts are not empty-result evidence.
No competitor photograph fetched/copied. Incidental property-portal search hits were discarded.
No protected street-view screenshot or challenge bypass. No new media upload.
No Cursor agents, Neon/database access, migration/data patch, merge or production promotion.

Wider Hong Kong/expanded-region responses were character-limited discovery only, not exhaustive pagination or estate matches. See exact query records below.
